frozen_scientific_scope.original_scope: Planned fossil-form study featuring flat open spiral keeps successive ribbed whorls visibly separated.
frozen_scientific_scope.representation: fossil-specimen, holotype-informed low-poly interpretation; unseen thickness inferred explicitly

scale.basis: Tablep26 gives D54.5,H12,h8.5,U36mm forRGM197188A; widthW is blank. Working9mm axial thickness is an explicitly uncertain inference from described subellipsoidal section, not measured specimen width.
scale.uncertainty: Do not confuseH/h with wall thickness. Approximate axial thickness8–12mm is acceptable without claiming anatomical calibration; diameter about55mm. Original body was not a flat2D extrusion.

uncertainty: Only one lateral image exists in the selected source; axial thickness, backside and fine three-dimensional rib shape are conservatively inferred from published section description, not observed in independent angles.
WidthW is explicitly not reported. Maker must not write9mm as measured holotype width or certify a photogrammetric replica.
Unpreserved early micro-whorls and terminal shell beyond the fossil are not restored. Preserved morphology remains sufficient to express original natural open planar spiral.
Later taxonomic changes were not identified in the sources checked; use2010 primary identification and its specimen number rather than C.nolani or an unverified dealer specimen.
